areas.name: Self Care
areas.description: Building healthy habits and emotional wellness

maker.title: The Builder
maker.line: {name} is drawn to making things that work. Give {him} materials, time and a problem worth fixing.

teller.title: The Storyteller
teller.line: {name} reaches for words and worlds. Audiences, journals and stages will feed this.

leader.title: The Leader
leader.line: {name} wants a team and a direction. Let {him} run something real, however small.

explorer.title: The Explorer
explorer.line: {name} is pulled towards the unfamiliar. New places and open questions keep {him} alight.

thinker.title: The Solver
thinker.line: {name} likes a puzzle with a locked door. Give {him} harder ones than you think {he} can take.

helper.title: The Helper
helper.line: {name} measures {himself} by who {he} lift{s}. Responsibility for others will grow {him} fastest.

rest.title: The Recharger
rest.line: {name} refills in quiet. Protect {his} downtime instead of filling it.

body.title: The Body Listener
body.line: {name} feels things physically first. Food, air and movement change {his} mood fastest.

feelings.title: The Feeler
feelings.line: {name} is ready to name what {he} feel{s}. Keep asking, and keep the answers safe.

order.title: The Steady One
order.line: {name} does better with rhythm than with rules. Build the routine with {him}.

joy.title: The Joy Seeker
joy.line: {name} resets through fun. An hour of nothing useful is doing real work.

curious.title: The Question Machine
curious.line: {name} learns by asking. Answer two, then hand the third back to {him}.

logic.title: The Pattern Finder
logic.line: {name} enjoys order in a mess. Puzzles, codes and strategy games suit {him}.

evidence.title: The Fact Checker
evidence.line: {name} wants to know how you know. Show {him} where to look it up.

invent.title: The Rule Bender
invent.line: {name} reshapes the problem rather than solving it as given. Leave room for that.

patient.title: The Long Thinker
patient.line: {name} can stay with something difficult. Resist rescuing {him} too early.

make.title: The Maker
make.line: {name} thinks with {his} hands. Keep raw materials within reach.

story.title: The Storyteller
story.line: {name} turns everything into narrative. Give {him} somewhere to publish it.

perform.title: The Performer
perform.line: {name} needs an audience to come alive. Find {him} a small stage.

imagine.title: The Dreamer
imagine.line: {name} builds whole worlds internally. Unstructured time is not wasted on {him}.

mix.title: The Remixer
mix.line: {name} collides ideas that do not belong together. Expose {him} to more of them.

speed.title: The Sprinter
speed.line: {name} is built for bursts. Short, sharp challenges hold {him}.

strength.title: The Strong One
strength.line: {name} enjoys the effort itself. Give {him} something heavy and safe to work at.

skill.title: The Skill Collector
skill.line: {name} will drill one move for weeks. Reward the practice, not just the result.

team.title: The Teammate
team.line: {name} moves best beside other people. Team sport beats solo training here.

outdoors.title: The Outdoor Kid
outdoors.line: {name} regulates {himself} outside. Long days out do more than any programme.

friend.title: The Friend Maker
friend.line: {name} invests in people one at a time. Depth matters more than numbers.

lead.title: The Natural Lead
lead.line: {name} organises the room without being asked. Give {him} something to be in charge of.

listen.title: The Listener
listen.line: {name} holds what others tell {him}. Make sure someone is listening to {him} too.

kind.title: The Kind One
kind.line: {name} notices who is left out. Name it when you see it.

brave.title: The Brave Voice
brave.line: {name} will speak when it costs {him} something. Back {him} publicly.
